pages.title: Acheronite Tools
pages.text: $(bold)Netherite-tier durability.$() Standard patterns with Refined Acheronite and sticks.
$(bold)Orbital Scan #0076$()$(br2)$(flavor)"Does the blade cauterize on contact?"$(br)"Send someone down to check."$()

pages.title: Acheronite Pickaxe
pages.text: Mines frozen obsidian like butter.$(br2)$(flavor)Very cold butter.$()

pages.title: Acheronite Blade
pages.text: Enemies shatter on impact.$(br2)Recovered $(l:orsa_rd/soul_harvesting)Architect Souls$(/l) can be fused into the blade later, if your ethics have fully frozen over.

pages.title: Acheronite Axe
pages.text: $(flavor)For dead trees, and anything that looks at you wrong.$()
